feeds.title: Education Week
feeds.description: Check out the news, analysis, and opinion about K-12 education in Kentucky. Since 1981, Education Week has been America's most trusted resource for K-12 education news and information. Education Week's diverse audience turns to us for the most up-to-date information on K-12 education in the U.S., as well as innovative, high-value tools and solutions.

feeds.title: Kentucky Teacher
feeds.description: News for the Nation's Most Innovative Educators. The Kentucky Department of Education (KDE) publishes Kentucky Teacher to communicate directly with the state's 40,000 public school teachers. The stories of this award-winning publication include news, perspectives, and practical, workable ideas for guiding students to higher levels of achievement.

feeds.title: Prichard Committee for Academic Excellence Blog
feeds.description: The Collaborative for Families & Schools is a network of families, schools, and community partners supporting local innovation and collaboration to meet the unique needs of every Kentucky child to improve learning outcomes and student success. Since 1983, the Prichard Committee has worked to study priority issues, inform the public and policymakers about best practices and mobilize citizens, business leaders, families, students, and other stakeholders in a shared mission to move Kentucky to the top tier of all states.

feeds.title: Providence Montessori School Blog
feeds.description: The Providence Montessori School blog is a great resource for Montessori parents who want to learn more about Montessori and Montessori parenting. The school's mission is to provide a quality environment, holistic in its approach, which unleashes in the children their natural curiosity, their intrinsic desire for life-long learning, and their innate ability to be citizens who better the world.

feeds.title: Kentucky Campus Compact Blog
feeds.description: Kentucky Campus Compact Blog updates you with the latest news and information. Kentucky Campus Compact (KyCC) was created in 2005 by a task force of Kentucky college and university presidents and has been housed at Northern Kentucky University since January 2006.

feeds.title: Commonwealth Educational Opportunities Blog
feeds.description: Commonwealth Educational Opportunities Blog share their posts about education, politics, and more. Commonwealth Educational Opportunities advances public policies that put Kentucky students first. As a grassroots organization, they identify, organize, and train Kentuckians to support conservative educational policies based on limited government and free market principles.

feeds.title: Eastern Kentucky University Blog
feeds.description: Visit Eastern Kentucky University's online news and blog page for the most recent articles and news stories about their students and faculty. EKU is consistently recognized as one of the best online colleges in the nation. The University offers more than 100 online options in various areas of study, designed for adult learners who want to earn a college degree or certificate while working full-time or juggling other life priorities.

feeds.title: Kentucky Association of School Superintendents Blog
feeds.description: Explore the most recent blogs by the Kentucky Association of School Superintendents. The mission of KASS is to develop the capacity of Superintendents, and those who aspire to the Superintendency, to reach their full potential in transforming their educational systems to produce students who successfully compete in a global society.

feeds.title: Kids First Kentucky
feeds.description: The latest news articles, legislative updates and the most recent blog post about supporting public schools to put Kids First in Kentucky. Kids First Kentucky ensures students, teachers, and schools are equipped with the resources they need to be at their best every day.

feeds.title: Bluegrass Institute Blog
feeds.description: The Bluegrass Institute is an independent research and educational institution offering free-market solutions to Kentucky's most pressing public policy issues. Their vision at the Bluegrass Institute for Public Policy Solutions is to move Kentucky from dependency to prosperity by leading their commonwealth forward on the policy issues that advance free markets, expand liberty and result in smaller, more transparent government.
